scope: Reactive membership nickname cache expiry, bounded visibility reload, HMR cleanup and profile avatar error fallback
baselineFailures: Mounted nickname computed kept stale style after clock exceeded existing TTL without another reactive event
Disposed HMR module could schedule new style work while notifying old watchers
Actual public profile screenshot showed broken avatar; component had no load-error handler
changes: One shared earliest-expiry timer prunes reactive cache and name aliases, then uses existing observer/batch queue for visible reloads
Offscreen nodes lose stale CSS but do not fetch until observed; same-batch entries share timestamp
Logout/reset/HMR dispose cancels timers and late jobs; disposed module cannot requeue itself
Profile image falls back once to existing local default, keeps stored URL intact and keys image by source
limits: Exact expiry threshold uses deterministic clock; live browser observes before/after natural expiry, not millisecond deadline accuracy
HMR late-response and observer permutations use actual setup/component with controlled API/observer, not all real browser fault races
Profile avatar fallback does not assert every other image consumer or remote provider availability
